text: Characters by world

source.page_title: List of Honkai: Star Rail characters

text: Herta Space Station Arlan ( 阿兰 ; Ālán ) Voiced by : Tao Dian ( Chinese ) ; Dani Chambers ( English ) ; Ryoko Shiraishi ( Japanese ) ; Kim Yul ( Korean ) Arlan is the head of the space station 's security department .

source.page_title: List of Honkai: Star Rail characters

text: Asta ( 艾丝妲 ; Àisīdá ) Voiced by : Guiniang ( Chinese ) ; Felecia Angelle ( English ) ; Chinatsu Akasaki ( Japanese ) ; Kim Hyeon - ji ( Korean ) Asta is an astronomer and the space station 's lead researcher who comes from a wealthy family .

source.page_title: List of Honkai: Star Rail characters

text: Arlan often has to rein in her spending .

source.page_title: List of Honkai: Star Rail characters

text: Herta ( 黑塔 ; Hēitǎ )

source.page_title: List of Honkai: Star Rail characters

text: Voiced by : Hou Xiaofei ( Chinese ) ; PJ Mattson ( English ) ; Haruka Yamazaki ( Japanese ) ; Kim Seo-yeong ( Korean )

source.page_title: List of Honkai: Star Rail characters

text: The space station 's true master and the interest - driven member # 83 of the Genius Society .

source.page_title: List of Honkai: Star Rail characters

text: Herta is an Emanator of Erudition who controls her namesake puppets , loosely modelled after her younger self , scattered throughout the space station .

source.page_title: List of Honkai: Star Rail characters

text: To distinguish herself between the puppets , she refers to herself as The Herta ( 大黑塔 ; Dà Hēitǎ ) .

source.page_title: List of Honkai: Star Rail characters

text: Ruan Mei ( 阮·梅 ; Ruǎn Méi )

source.page_title: List of Honkai: Star Rail characters

text: Voiced by : Zhang Wenyu ( Chinese ) ; Emi Lo ( English ) ; Saori Ōnishi ( Japanese ) ; Yoon Yeo - jin ( Korean ) Ruan Mei is a biological sciences expert and member # 81 of the Genius Society .

source.page_title: List of Honkai: Star Rail characters

text: She is a completely amoral scientist with dreams of becoming an Aeon herself , though she regrets being unable to emotionally connect with her creations .

source.page_title: List of Honkai: Star Rail characters

text: Jarilo - VI Bronya Rand ( 布洛妮娅·兰德 ; Bùluònīyà Lándé )

source.page_title: List of Honkai: Star Rail characters

text: Voiced by : Xie Ying ( Chinese ) ; Madeline Reiter ( English ) ; Kana Asumi ( Japanese ) ; Lee Bo-hee ( Korean )

source.page_title: List of Honkai: Star Rail characters

text: The commander of the Silvermane Guards and Cocolia 's adoptive daughter .

source.page_title: List of Honkai: Star Rail characters

text: Bronya became the ruler of Jarilo - VI 's only inhabited city , Belobog , after Cocolia 's death .

source.page_title: List of Honkai: Star Rail characters

text: Clara ( 克拉拉 ; Kèlālā ) Voiced by : Zisu Jiuyue ( Chinese ) ; Emily Sun ( English ) ; Rina Hidaka ( Japanese ) ; Kim Yea-lim ( Korean ) ( Clara ) Voiced by : Wang Yuhang ( Chinese ) ; D. C. Douglas ( English ) ; Hiroki Yasumoto ( Japanese ) ; Choi Nak - yoon ( Korean ) ( Svarog ) Clara is a mild - mannered young girl and a self - taught mechanic .

source.page_title: List of Honkai: Star Rail characters

text: She is often accompanied by the robot Svarog ( 史瓦罗 ; Shǐwǎluó ) .

source.page_title: List of Honkai: Star Rail characters

text: Gepard Landau ( 杰帕德·朗道 ; Jiépàdé Lǎngdào )

source.page_title: List of Honkai: Star Rail characters

text: Voiced by : Ma Yang ( Chinese ) ; Bryson Baugus ( English ) ; Makoto Furukawa ( Japanese ) ; Min Seung - woo ( Korean )

source.page_title: List of Honkai: Star Rail characters

text: The dutiful captain of the Silvermane Guards , who is Serval 's and Lynx 's brother .

source.page_title: List of Honkai: Star Rail characters

text: Gepard is the middle sibling of the Landau family .

source.page_title: List of Honkai: Star Rail characters

text: Hook ( 虎克 ; Hǔkè ) Voiced by : Wang Xiaotong ( Chinese ) ; Felecia Angelle ( English ) ; Sora Tokui ( Japanese ) ; Lee Jae-hyun ( Korean ) Hook is the self - proclaimed boss of the Moles , a group of children who go on adventures and play pranks throughout the underground region of Belobog , known as the Underworld .

source.page_title: List of Honkai: Star Rail characters

text: Luka ( 卢卡 ; Lúkǎ ) Voiced by : Xiao Zhai ( Chinese ) ; Howard Wang ( English ) ; Gakuto Kajiwara ( Japanese ) ; Lee Joo-seung ( Korean ) Luka is a fighter and a member of Wildfire , a grassroots organization based in the Underworld .

source.page_title: List of Honkai: Star Rail characters

text: He tries to support his friends and neighbors , even at his own expense .

source.page_title: List of Honkai: Star Rail characters

text: Lynx Landau ( 玲可·朗道 ; Língkě Lǎngdào ) Voiced by : Mihu ( Chinese ) ; Risa Mei ( English ) ; Haruka Terui ( Japanese ) ; Lee Eun-jo ( Korean ) Lynx is a polar explorer who is Serval 's and Gepard 's sister .

source.page_title: List of Honkai: Star Rail characters

text: She is the youngest sibling of the Landau family , as well as a friend of Pela .

source.page_title: List of Honkai: Star Rail characters

text: She is also the keyboardist of the musical band Mechanical Fever .

source.page_title: List of Honkai: Star Rail characters

text: Natasha ( 娜塔莎 ; Nàtǎshā ) Voiced by : Qin Ziyi ( Chinese ) ; Elizabeth Maxwell ( English ) ; Yumi Uchiyama ( Japanese ) ; Gang Eun-ae ( Korean ) Natasha is a doctor and the true leader of Wildfire .

source.page_title: List of Honkai: Star Rail characters

text: Pelageya " Pela " Sergeyevna ( 佩拉格娅· 谢尔盖耶夫娜 ; Pèilāgéyà Xiè'ěrgàiyēfūnà )

source.page_title: List of Honkai: Star Rail characters

text: Voiced by : Yanning ( Chinese ) ; Xanthe Huynh ( English ) ; Sumire Morohoshi ( Japanese ) ; Lee Da-eun ( Korean )

source.page_title: List of Honkai: Star Rail characters

text: The intelligence officer of the Silvermane Guards .

source.page_title: List of Honkai: Star Rail characters

text: Pela is a friend of Lynx and the drummer of Mechanical Fever .

source.page_title: List of Honkai: Star Rail characters

text: Seele ( 希儿 ; Xī'ér ) Voiced by : Tang Yajing ( Chinese ) ; Molly Zhang ( English ) ; Mai Nakahara ( Japanese ) ; Song Ha-rim ( Korean ) Seele is a spirited member of Wildfire .

source.page_title: List of Honkai: Star Rail characters

text: She grew up at the same orphanage as Bronya .

source.page_title: List of Honkai: Star Rail characters

text: Serval Landau ( 希露瓦·朗道 ; Xīlùwǎ Lǎngdào ) Voiced by : Mu Xueting ( Chinese ) ; Natalie Van Sistine ( English ) ; Aimi ( Japanese ) ; Min-a ( Korean ) Serval is a brilliant mechanic who is Gepard 's and Lynx 's sister .

source.page_title: List of Honkai: Star Rail characters

text: She is the eldest sibling of the Landau family and her affection for rock n' roll is evident in her role as the lead vocalist and guitarist of Mechanical Fever .

source.page_title: List of Honkai: Star Rail characters

text: Xianzhou Alliance

source.page_title: List of Honkai: Star Rail characters

text: Bailu ( 白露 ; Báilù ) Voiced by : Duoduo ( Chinese ) ; Su Ling Chan ( English ) ; Emiri Katō ( Japanese ) ; Cho Hyun - jung ( Korean ) Bailu is a Vidyadhara doctor of the Alchemy Commission on the Luofu .

source.page_title: List of Honkai: Star Rail characters

text: She often tries to escape her responsibilities .

source.page_title: List of Honkai: Star Rail characters

text: She is the heir apparent to the Imbibitor Lunae .

source.page_title: List of Honkai: Star Rail characters

text: Feixiao ( 飞霄 ; Fēixiāo ) Voiced by : Ye Zhiqiu ( Chinese ) ; Anairis Quiñones ( English ) ; Mikako Komatsu ( Japanese ) ; Son Jung - min ( Korean ) Feixiao , whose real name is Saran ( 萨兰 ; Sàlán ) , is one of the seven Arbiter - Generals , the top officers of the Cloud Knights .

source.page_title: List of Honkai: Star Rail characters

text: She serves as the general of the Xianzhou Yaoqing .

source.page_title: List of Honkai: Star Rail characters

text: She is a foxian , a humanoid species with fox - like features , but has some canine - like features from her borisin ancestry .

source.page_title: List of Honkai: Star Rail characters

text: This ancestry also afflicts her with Moon Rage , a condition akin to lycanthropy .

source.page_title: List of Honkai: Star Rail characters

text: Fu Xuan ( 符玄 ; Fú Xuán ) Voiced by : Hualing ( Chinese ) ; Sarah Wiedenheft ( English ) ; Miku Itō ( Japanese ) ; Lee Ji-hyeon ( Korean )

source.page_title: List of Honkai: Star Rail characters

text: The head of the Divination Commission on the Luofu .

source.page_title: List of Honkai: Star Rail characters

text: Fu Xuan is the prospective successor for Jing Yuan as Arbiter - General for the Luofu.

source.page_title: List of Honkai: Star Rail characters

text: Guinaifen ( 桂乃芬 ; Guìnǎifēn ) Voiced by : Xiao Gan ( Chinese ) ; Morgan Lauré ( English ) ; Hina Suguta ( Japanese ) ; Kim Su-yeong ( Korean ) Guinaifen is a street performer who resides on the Luofu after the Antimatter Legion destroyed her home planet .

source.page_title: List of Honkai: Star Rail characters

text: Her real name is Guinevere ( 格妮薇儿 ; Génīwēi'er ) , which is localized as Guinaifen by her friend Sushang .

source.page_title: List of Honkai: Star Rail characters

text: Hanya ( 寒鸦 ; Hányā ) Voiced by : Zhang Yuxi ( Chinese ) ; Suzie Yeung ( English ) ; Sayumi Suzushiro ( Japanese ) ; Yoon Eun-seo ( Korean ) Hanya is a judge of the Ten - Lords Commission on the Luofu who has become numb after becoming flooded with work and haunted by nightmares .

source.page_title: List of Honkai: Star Rail characters

text: She is Xueyi 's younger sister .

source.page_title: List of Honkai: Star Rail characters

text: Huaiyan ( 怀炎 ; Huáiyán ) Voiced by : Li Haojia ( Chinese ) ; J. Michael Tatum ( English ) ; Tadashi Miyazawa ( Japanese ) ; Jo Min-soo ( Korean ) Huaiyan is one of the seven Arbiter - Generals and the general of the Xianzhou Zhuming .

source.page_title: List of Honkai: Star Rail characters

text: He is Yunli 's adoptive grandfather .

source.page_title: List of Honkai: Star Rail characters

text: Huohuo ( 藿藿 ; Huòhuò ) Voiced by : Ge Zirui ( Chinese ) ; Courtney Lin ( 2023 – 2024 ) , Megan Shipman ( 2024 – present ) ( English ) ; Maria Naganawa ( Japanese ) ; Kim Chae - rin ( Korean ) ( Huohuo ) Voiced by : Liu Beichen ( Chinese ) ; Adam Michael Gold ( 2023 – 2024 ) , Aaron Veach ( 2024 – present ) ( English ) ; Takeshi Hirabayashi ( Japanese ) ; Han Bok-hyun ( Korean ) ( Tail ) Huohuo is a foxian trainee judge of the Ten - Lords Commission on the Luofu .

source.page_title: List of Honkai: Star Rail characters

text: She has a fear of inhuman beings , but ironically attracts them due to a heliobus , a spirit - like being , whom she calls " Mr. Tail " ( 尾巴 ; Wěiba ) , sealed in her tail by the other judges .

source.page_title: List of Honkai: Star Rail characters

text: Jiaoqiu ( 椒丘 ; Jiāoqiū ) Voiced by : Chenzhang Taikang ( Chinese ) ; Mark Whitten ( English ) ; Toshiyuki Toyonaga ( Japanese ) ; Lee Jung - min ( Korean ) Jiaoqiu is a foxian counselor and a healer of the Alchemy Commission on the Yaoqing who was blinded after poisoning his blood to stall the borisin leader , Hoolay .

source.page_title: List of Honkai: Star Rail characters

text: Jing Yuan ( 景元 ; Jǐng Yuán ) Voiced by : Sun Ye , Zhong Ke ( young ) ( Chinese ) ; Alejandro Saab , Brenna Larsen ( young ) ( English ) ; Daisuke Ono , Yūka Matsumi ( young ) ( Japanese ) ; Ryu Seung - gon , Kim Yea-lim ( young ) ( Korean ) Jing Yuan is one of the seven Arbiter - Generals and the general of the Luofu.

source.page_title: List of Honkai: Star Rail characters

text: Jingliu ( 镜流 ; Jìngli ú )

source.page_title: List of Honkai: Star Rail characters

text: Voiced by : Du Mingya ( Chinese ) ; AmaLee ( English ) ; Houko Kuwashima ( Japanese ) ; Park Yi-seo ( Korean )

source.page_title: List of Honkai: Star Rail characters

text: The leader of the now - defunct group , the High - Cloud Quintet .

source.page_title: List of Honkai: Star Rail characters

text: Jingliu was the sword master of the Luofu and Jing Yuan 's mentor until she succumbed to mara , a curse that caused its host to become insane , and began attacking her former allies .

source.page_title: List of Honkai: Star Rail characters

text: Li Sushang ( 李素裳 ; Lǐ Sùshang ) Voiced by : Chen Tingting ( Chinese ) ; Anjali Kunapaneni ( English ) ; Misato Fukuen ( Japanese ) ; Park Shi-yoon ( Korean ) Sushang is a young Cloud Knight who wields a large sword and yearns to become a legend .

source.page_title: List of Honkai: Star Rail characters

text: A friend of Guinaifen , she assists in some of her acrobatic stunts and almost always appears in her livestreams .

source.page_title: List of Honkai: Star Rail characters

text: Lingsha ( 灵砂 ; Língshā ) Voiced by : Rao Zijun ( Chinese ) ; Whitney Holland ( English ) ; Kaori Maeda ( Japanese ) ; Jang Ye-na ( Korean ) Lingsha , whose real name is Dan Zhu ( 丹朱 ; Dān Zhū ) , is a Vidyadhara healer and the head of the Alchemy Commission on the Luofu.

source.page_title: List of Honkai: Star Rail characters

text: Luocha ( 罗刹 ; Luóchà )

source.page_title: List of Honkai: Star Rail characters

text: Voiced by : Zhao Lu ( Chinese ) ; Craig Lee Thomas ( English ) ; Akira Ishida ( Japanese ) ; Shin Yong - woo ( Korean ) Luocha is a foreign trader who is often seen carrying a huge coffin .

source.page_title: List of Honkai: Star Rail characters

text: His true background is a mystery , but Jing Yuan suspects him of having smuggled a Stellaron onboard the Luofu , and Welt suspects him of being linked to Void Archives , Welt 's past acquaintance .

source.page_title: List of Honkai: Star Rail characters

text: Moze ( 貊泽 ; Mòzé ) Voiced by : Huang Jinze ( Chinese ) ; Ben Balmaceda ( English ) ; Shogo Sakata ( Japanese ) ; Choi Hyun - sik ( Korean ) Moze is a sneaky , fastidious assassin and Feixiao 's assistant .

source.page_title: List of Honkai: Star Rail characters

text: He usually remains hidden , only appearing when it 's time to assassinate his enemies .

source.page_title: List of Honkai: Star Rail characters

text: Qingque ( 青雀 ; Qīngquè ) Voiced by : Liu Shisi ( Chinese ) ; Bryn Apprill ( English ) ; Arisa Date ( Japanese ) ; Seo Da-hye ( Korean ) Qingque is a librarian and a diviner of the Divination Commission on the Luofu .

source.page_title: List of Honkai: Star Rail characters

text: Although incredibly intelligent , she prefers to spend her time slacking off and playing Celestial Jade , a tile - based game heavily inspired by mahjong , rather than working .

source.page_title: List of Honkai: Star Rail characters

text: Tingyun ( 停云 ; Tíngyún )

source.page_title: List of Honkai: Star Rail characters

text: Voiced by : Jiang Li ( Chinese ) ; Laci Morgan ( 2023 – 2024 ) , Anya Floris ( 2024 – present ) ( English ) ; Yūki Takada ( Japanese ) ; Lee Myeong - ho ( Korean ) Tingyun is an eloquent foxian and a trade envoy of the Sky - Faring Commission on the Luofu .

source.page_title: List of Honkai: Star Rail characters

text: During the Xianzhou Luofu chapter , the Tingyun encountered by the Astral Express crew was not the real one , but a vessel possessed by Phantylia , who had stolen her identity and presumably killed her .

source.page_title: List of Honkai: Star Rail characters

text: The real Tingyun was later rescued from the brink of death by Ruan Mei and became known as Fugue ( 忘归人 ; Wàngguīrén ) .

source.page_title: List of Honkai: Star Rail characters

text: Xueyi ( 雪衣 ; Xuěyī )

source.page_title: List of Honkai: Star Rail characters

text: Voiced by : Suxun ( Chinese ) ; Jenny Yokobori ( English ) ; Maki Kawase ( Japanese ) ; Park Ri-na ( Korean ) Xueyi is a judge of the Ten - Lords Commission on the Luofu and Hanya 's older sister .

source.page_title: List of Honkai: Star Rail characters

text: Her natural body was destroyed , but she was resurrected into a puppet body .

source.page_title: List of Honkai: Star Rail characters

text: Yao Guang ( 爻光 ; Yáo Guāng ) Voiced by : Qin Ziyi ( Chinese ) ; Ari Thrash ( English ) ; Kana Hanazawa ( Japanese ) ; Lee Seul ( Korean ) Yao Guang is one of the seven Arbiter - Generals and the general of the Xianzhou Yuque .

source.page_title: List of Honkai: Star Rail characters

text: Yanqing ( 彦卿 ; Yànqīng ) Voiced by : Miao Jiang ( Chinese ) ; Amber May ( English ) ; Marina Inoue ( Japanese ) ; Lee Sae-a ( Korean )

source.page_title: List of Honkai: Star Rail characters

text: The lieutenant of the Cloud Knights on the Luofu and Jing Yuan 's retainer .

source.page_title: List of Honkai: Star Rail characters

text: Yanqing seeks to become the Luofu 's sword master .

source.page_title: List of Honkai: Star Rail characters

text: Yukong ( 驭空 ; Yùkōng ) Voiced by : Zhong Ke ( Chinese ) ; Dawn M. Bennett ( English ) ; Yumi Tōma ( Japanese ) ; Jeon Sook - kyeong ( Korean ) Yukong is a foxian former wartime pilot and the head of the Sky - Faring Commission on the Luofu .

source.page_title: List of Honkai: Star Rail characters

text: Yunli ( 云璃 ; Yúnlí )

source.page_title: List of Honkai: Star Rail characters

text: Voiced by : Liu Wen ( Chinese ) ; Brenna Larsen ( English ) ; Shion Wakayama ( Japanese ) ; Lee Ju-eun ( Korean ) Yunli is a sword hunter from the Zhuming and the adoptive granddaughter of Huaiyan .

source.page_title: List of Honkai: Star Rail characters

text: Gallagher ( 加拉赫 ; Jiālāhè ) Voiced by : Ma Yufei ( Chinese ) ; Erik Braa ( English ) ; Satoshi Mikami ( Japanese ) ; Park Sang - hoon ( Korean ) Gallagher is a security officer of the Bloodhound family who also works as a bartender .

source.page_title: List of Honkai: Star Rail characters

text: He is the result of an amalgamation of traits from present inhabitants of Penacony .

source.page_title: List of Honkai: Star Rail characters

text: His actual identity is that of an agent of the Path of Enigmata , an ally of the Watchmaker , and the keeper of the entity known as " Dormancy " .

source.page_title: List of Honkai: Star Rail characters

text: Misha ( 米沙 ; Mǐshā ) Voiced by : Liu Zhixiao ( Chinese ) ; Cat Protano ( English ) ; Eriko Matsui ( Japanese ) ; Bak Sin-hee ( Korean ) Misha is a bellboy at the Reverie Hotel .

source.page_title: List of Honkai: Star Rail characters

text: His existence is a reflection of the Watchmaker ( 「 钟表匠 」 ; " Zhōngbiǎojiàng " ) , whose real name is Mikhail Char Legwork ( 拉格沃克·夏 尔·米哈伊尔 ; Lāgéwòkè Xià'ěr Mǐhāyī'ěr ) .

source.page_title: List of Honkai: Star Rail characters

text: Robin ( 知更鸟 ; Zhīgēngniǎo )

source.page_title: List of Honkai: Star Rail characters

text: Voiced by : Qian Chen ( Chinese ) ; Alice Himora ( English ) ; Kaori Nazuka ( Japanese ) ; Shin On - yu ( Korean ) ; Chevy ( song vocals ) Robin is an elegant Halovian singer and Sunday 's sister .

source.page_title: List of Honkai: Star Rail characters

text: She uses the Path of Harmony to spread her music throughout the cosmos .

source.page_title: List of Honkai: Star Rail characters

text: Aglaea ( 阿格莱雅 ; Āgéláiy ǎ )

source.page_title: List of Honkai: Star Rail characters

text: Voiced by : Chu Yue ( Chinese ) ; Morgan Lauré ( English ) ; Aya Endō ( Japanese ) ; Oh Ro-ah ( Korean ) Aglaea is one of the Chrysos Heirs , a group of heroes destined to inherit cores of the Titans ' power called Coreflames , and serves as the demigod of Romance .

source.page_title: List of Honkai: Star Rail characters

text: She is the leader of the Chrysos Heirs and a weaver who uses golden threads .

source.page_title: List of Honkai: Star Rail characters

text: Anaxa ( 那刻夏 ; Nàkèxià ) Voiced by : Qian Wenqing ( Chinese ) ; Stephen Fu ( English ) ; Yuma Uchida ( Japanese ) ; Lee Sang - jun ( Korean ) Anaxagoras ( 阿那克萨戈拉斯 ; Ānàkèsàgēlāsī ) is one of the Chrysos Heirs and the demigod of Reason .

source.page_title: List of Honkai: Star Rail characters

text: He is an enlightened scholar from the city of Grove of Epiphany .

source.page_title: List of Honkai: Star Rail characters

text: Castorice ( 遐蝶 ; Xiádié )

source.page_title: List of Honkai: Star Rail characters

text: Voiced by : Ruan Congqing ( Chinese ) ; Melody Muze ( English ) ; Chiwa Saitō ( Japanese ) ; Serena Lee ( Korean ) Castorice is one of the Chrysos Heirs and the demigod of Death .

source.page_title: List of Honkai: Star Rail characters

text: She is an executioner by virtue of possessing the touch of death .

source.page_title: List of Honkai: Star Rail characters

text: Cerydra ( 刻律德菈 ; Kèlǜdélā )

source.page_title: List of Honkai: Star Rail characters

text: Voiced by : Shi Xinlei ( Chinese ) ; Rhiannon Moushall ( English ) ; Kanon Takao ( Japanese ) ; Kim Yun-chae ( Korean ) Cerydra is one of the Chrysos Heirs and the demigod of Law .

source.page_title: List of Honkai: Star Rail characters

text: She is an arrogant tyrant who once ruled as the self - proclaimed ruler of the city of Okhema .

source.page_title: List of Honkai: Star Rail characters

text: Cipher ( 赛飞儿 ; Sàifēi'ér )

source.page_title: List of Honkai: Star Rail characters

text: Voiced by : Wang Yaxin ( Chinese ) ; Shea Fairaday ( English ) ; Ayasa Itō ( Japanese ) ; Mi So ( Korean ) Cifera ( 赛法利娅 ; Sàifǎlìy à ) is one of the Chrysos Heirs and the demigod of Trickery .

source.page_title: List of Honkai: Star Rail characters

text: She is a nimble kleptomaniac catgirl from the city of Dolos .

text: Reception Many critics praised Honkai : Star Rail for continuing HoYoverse 's tradition of strong character design , highlighting the game 's vivid , expressive , and well - developed cast .

source.page_title: List of Honkai: Star Rail characters

text: Gamer reviewer Tyler Colp remarked that each character in the game " glows with personality , " and that their combat animations are " extraordinarily expressive . "

source.page_title: List of Honkai: Star Rail characters

text: GamesHub reviewer Samantha Low described the characters as engaging , with flashy designs reminiscent of a techwear runway , emphasizing their visual appeal and distinctive personalities .

source.page_title: List of Honkai: Star Rail characters

text: According to IGN China reviewer Water Ash , the character designs appeal to a broad range of fan preferences , with facial expressions and animations during dialogue presented in a detailed and nuanced manner .

source.page_title: List of Honkai: Star Rail characters

text: PCGamesN reviewer Nat Smith observed that the characters possess strong individual appeal , describing them as familiar archetypes that evoke the nostalgic charm of 1990s Japanese role - playing games .

source.page_title: List of Honkai: Star Rail characters

text: Smith also highlighted the game 's NPCs , noting that even minor figures often play pivotal roles in the narrative , enhancing the game 's world - building .

source.page_title: List of Honkai: Star Rail characters

text: IGN reviewer Jess Reyes observed that the game reveals character traits gradually through different scenarios , enhancing the narrative 's suspense and engagement .

text: Casting of Chris Niosi

source.page_title: List of Honkai: Star Rail characters

text: In July 2024 , HoYoverse revealed the English voice actor for the character Moze to be Chris Niosi .

source.page_title: List of Honkai: Star Rail characters

text: Immediately after the reveal , HoYoverse received backlash from players due to Niosi 's past abuse allegations in 2019 , which were affirmed by Niosi himself .

source.page_title: List of Honkai: Star Rail characters

text: Following the backlash , Niosi withdrew from the role days later and HoYoverse replaced him with Ben Balmaceda .

source.page_title: List of Honkai: Star Rail characters

text: Niosi 's recorded voice lines were later fully replaced in subsequent versions , and Moze debuted with Balmaceda as his English voice actor .

source.page_title: List of Honkai: Star Rail characters

text: SAG -AFTRA strike controversies

source.page_title: List of Honkai: Star Rail characters

text: From 2024 to 2025 , HoYoverse was affected by strike action from multiple English voice actors affiliated with SAG -AFTRA .

source.page_title: List of Honkai: Star Rail characters

text: Although HoYoverse was n't listed as one of the companies targeted in the main strike , multiple English voice actors in support of the strike stopped voicing their assigned characters .

source.page_title: List of Honkai: Star Rail characters

text: HoYoverse responded by replacing some of the striking voice actors , including the voice actors for the Trailblazer , Tingyun , Argenti , and Tail .
